selection: Take the first row for every distinct (field_prime,target_index,offsets) query in the archived selected vector (2,-1), preserving source order; this gives 512 distinct query events including every public doubling relation and every public nonrelation.
lift: For U=(X,Y) on y^2=x^3-x-2 over F_p, choose centered integer x,y and centered integer s congruent to (3X^2-1)/(2Y) mod p. Define A=2ys-3x^2, B=y^2-x^3-Ax, u=s^2-2x, v=s(x-u)-y. Form P=(x,y), R=(u,v) on y^2=x^3+Ax+B. Compare R mod p with archived V and independently test 2P=R, curve reduction, and target scalar replay.
exception_policy: Retain and count U at infinity, Y=0, singular rational curve, bad reduction, R-reduction mismatch, or audit failure; do not omit exceptional query events.
measurement: exact construction and correctness counts, no wall-time comparison or performance claim
